Wir sagen Ihnen das Geheimnis: es sind die Puya Paprika. Was ist die Frage? Das liegt an Ihnen. Wir machen hier nur heiße Saucen. אנחנו נספר לכם את הסוד: זה פלפלי Puya. מה השאלה? זה תלוי בך; אנחנו רק מכינים רטבים חריפים כאן! טיילו לתוך כל מסעדה מזדמנת במקסיקו ותמצאו רוטב כמו זה על השולחן. הרוטב החריף המסורתי שלנו הוא מחווה אוהבת לרטבי שולחן אלה, בהתחשב בסיט סיט על ידי הוספת מרכיבים צפופים מזינים כמו זרעי פשתן, צ'יה וסלק זהב. כשמדובר ברוטב חריף, אנחנו מתקרבים אליו עם מנטליות "טעם ראשון, אש שנייה". הרטבים שלנו לא נועדו להיות מרדודים, לשרוף את הוושט שלך. אנו מקווים שאוהבי התבלינים בכל המעלות יוכלו להעריך את העובדה שאנו מוציאים את החום כדי להגביר את הטעם.

If you have always wanted to make it yourself this is your chance! Imagine having fresh Salsa Verde at your next BBQ right from your own garden. Green salsas are almost always more mild than red salsas. The main difference between regular salsa and salsa verde is that tomatillos are used instead of red tomatoes. Due to the tomatillos, salsa verde has a tangy, zesty flavor with the underlying tastes of hearty roasted green chiles and onions. Tomatillos bear prolifically and are known for being tolerant of extreme conditions from dry farming to even cool nights. Tomatillos grow encased in a papery shell very similar looking to a Chinese Lantern (flower). The papery shell turns from green to brown and splits when they are ready. At this point they may feel sticky but are ready in the green stage for salsa. If you leave them they will turn to a yellow. This variety of tomatillo can bear 2-4 oz. fruits. Tomatillos normally produce about a 1 pound of fruit per plant. So plant accordingly. Just imagine the surprise when you give a jar of Salsa Verde to your friends for Christmas!

Recipe Ingredients:
1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts, seasoned with salt and pepper
1 jar Corn, Black Bean Salsa

1 cup whole milk or half & half
3 cups fresh baby spinach leaves
1 cup shredded Parmesan cheese

description:
An accidental discovery, the first Worcestershire sauce was made in Worcester England, by John Wheeley Lea and William Perrins, a couple of pharmacists with a eye for culinary intrigue. Originally, the sauce was sold as both a flavoring and a digestive agent.

The sauce in question was actually a British attempt to recreate a fermented fish sauce called garum, a popular flavoring used in Italy and Greece. The anchovy-based recipe was flavored with tamarind, cloves, malt vinegar, onion, molasses, and other ingredients. However, the resulting sauce was so completely inedible that the remaining barrels were shelved aside. After time, however, the sauce had mellowed and fermented taking on a lovely flavor.

And that is Worcestershire sauce.

This sauce is just that but it’s been dehydrated and into a significantly more potent powder. It can be mixed with water to form a quick sauce, but we also love it in rubs for ribs or sprinkled onto a steak or ham during the last bits of cooking so it can form a Worcestershire glaze.

description:
Siete Habanero Hot Sauce
The Habanero is the tiger of chiles. Like the tiger, the pepper evokes ideas of exoticism, power, beauty, and fear. The challenge in making this sauce was to show the beauty and sweetness of the tiger, rather than the, y'know, Siegfried & Roy side. So we tamed the beast, adding golden beets, carrots, and dates to accentuate the pepper's sweetness, making the dangerous heat more of a through-line that conducts the orchestra of flavors than a solo artist. While this is the hottest of our sauces, it's a playful heat that we think you'll find pleasant in its restraint. That big scary predator is just a sweet cat at heart. When it comes to hot sauce, we approach it with a “flavor first, fire second” mentality. That’s why our Habanero Hot Sauce gets “3 out of 5 flames” for spiciness even though some habanero sauces are even spicier.

description:
The Coconut Secret Story, a true family story. When the founders of Coconut Secret learned their parents were diabetic, they began with a heartfelt desire to create an organic, low glycemic, gluten-free product line for diabetics. And that is precisely what happened. Hence the birth of the Coconut Aminos Garlic Seasoning Sauce. Leslie and Randy, founders, were rewarded and blessed beyond expectations, in their discovery of traditional products made from the sap of the wondrous coconut tree. Hence, the creation of an extensive line of coconut-based products to satisfy (and satiate) virtually every kind of craving. Their focus was to produce a product line that was not "processed" to eliminate the majority of naturally occurring nutrients and enzymes. They understood the importance for a healthy body to have naturally occurring nutrients and enzymes present allowing the body to naturally digest and utilize it nutritionally. These holistic values are critical to diabetics, and anyone who wants to build a healthier body. A holistic approach, coconut sugar is made by collecting the "sap" from the coconut tree blossoms. Bamboo containers are used to collect the sap of the coconut trees right at the blossoms. When the coconut trees are tapped, they produce a continuously flowing "inflorescence" (sap) that exudes from the coconut blossoms. This naturally sweet sap is very low glycemic (GI of 35), raw and enzymatically alive, an abundant source of 17 amino acids, minerals, vitamin C, broad-spectrum B vitamins, and has a nearly neutral pH. It is then minimally evaporated at low temperatures (only to remove excess moisture), never exceeding an average summer day in the tropics. The end result is a syrup-like product known as coconut "toddy" which is used to create an awesome tasting and healthy coconut sugar. הסיפור הסודי של הקוקוס, סיפור משפחתי אמיתי. כאשר המייסדים של Coconut Secret למדו שהוריהם היו סוכרתיים, הם החלו עם תשוקה מכל הלב ליצור קו מוצרים אורגני, גליקמי נמוך ונטול גלוטן לחולי סוכרת. וזה בדיוק מה שקרה. מכאן הולדתו של רוטב התיבול קוקוס אמינו. Leslie and Randy, מייסדים, זכו לתגמול ובורך מעבר לציפיות, בגילוי המוצרים המסורתיים העשויים מעץ הקוקוס המופלא. לפיכך, יצירת קו רחב של מוצרים מבוססי קוקוס כדי לספק (ו להשביע) כמעט כל סוג של תשוקה. ההתמקדות שלהם הייתה לייצר קו מוצרים שלא "מעובד" כדי לחסל את רוב החומרים המזינים והאנזימים המתרחשים באופן טבעי. הם הבינו את החשיבות של גוף בריא עם חומרים מזינים ואנזימים טבעיים הקיימים המאפשרים לגוף לעכל באופן טבעי ולנצל אותו באופן תזונתי. ערכים הוליסטיים אלה הם קריטיים לחולי סוכרת, וכל מי שרוצה לבנות גוף בריא יותר. גישה הוליסטית, סוכר קוקוס נעשה על ידי איסוף "סאפ" מפריחת עץ הקוקוס. מכלי במבוק משמשים לאיסוף התרופה של עצי הקוקוס ממש בפריחה. כאשר עצי הקוקוס מצומצמים, הם מייצרים "תפרחת" זורמת באופן רציף (סאפ) אשר נוטלת מפריחת הקוקוס. סאפ מתוק טבעי זה הוא גליקמי נמוך מאוד (GI של 35), גולמי וחי מבחינה אנזימטית, מקור בשפע של 17 חומצות אמינו, מינרלים, ויטמין C, ויטמינים B רחב טווח, ויש לו pH כמעט ניטרלי. לאחר מכן הוא מתאדה מינימלית בטמפרטורות נמוכות (רק כדי להסיר לחות עודפת), לעולם לא יעלה על יום קיץ ממוצע באזורים הטרופיים. התוצאה הסופית היא מוצר דמוי סירופ המכונה "טודי" קוקוס המשמש ליצירת טעם מדהים וסוכר קוקוס בריא. רוטב שום קוקוס אמינו הוא אורגני באישור משרד החקלאות האמריקאי, ללא סויה, אורגני, מוסמך (GF) ללא גלוטן, ללא הנדסה גנטית, ללא MSG, טבעוני וטעם נהדר.

The Coconut Secret Story, eine wahre Familiengeschichte. Als die Gründer von Coconut Secret lernten, ihre Eltern Diabetiker zu waren, begannen sie mit einem herzlichen Wunsch, eine organische, glykämische, glutenfreie Produktlinie für Diabetiker zu schaffen. Und genau das ist passiert. Daher die Geburt der Coconut Aminos Knoblauch-Sauce. Leslie und Randy, Gründer, wurden belohnt und gesegnet über die Erwartungen, in ihrer Entdeckung traditioneller Produkte aus dem Saft des wundersamen Kokosnussbaums. Daher ist die Schaffung einer umfangreichen Linie von Produkten auf Kokosnussbasis für praktisch jede Art von Verlangen (und sättigen) Befriedigung. Ihr Fokus war es, eine Produktlinie zu produzieren, die nicht "verarbeitet" wurde, um die Mehrheit der natürlich vorkommenden Nährstoffe und Enzyme zu beseitigen. Sie verstanden, wie wichtig für einen gesunden Körper ist, natürlich vorkommende Nährstoffe und Enzyme vorhanden zu haben, sodass der Körper auf natürliche Weise verdauen und nährungsphysiologisch verwertet werden kann. Diese ganzheitlichen Werte sind entscheidend für Diabetiker und alle, die einen gesünderen Körper aufbauen wollen. Ein ganzheitlicher Ansatz, Kokoszucker wird durch das Sammeln des "Saftes" aus den Kokosbaumblüten hergestellt. Bambusbehälter werden verwendet, um den Saft der Kokosbäume direkt an den Blüten zu sammeln. Wenn die Kokosbäume gezapft werden, produzieren sie einen kontinuierlich fließenden "Blütenblatt" (Sap), der aus den Kokosblüten ausströmt. Dieser natürlich süße Saft ist sehr niedrig glykämischer (GI von 35), roh und enzymatisch lebend, eine reichliche Quelle von 17 Aminosäuren, Mineralien, Vitamin C, Breitband-B-Vitaminen und hat einen nahezu neutralen pH-Wert. Es wird dann bei niedrigen Temperaturen minimal verdunstet (nur um überschüssige Feuchtigkeit zu entfernen), nie mehr einen durchschnittlichen Sommertag in den Tropen übersteigen. Das Endergebnis ist ein Sirup-ähnliches Produkt, das als Kokosnuss "Kleinkind" bekannt ist, das verwendet wird, um einen fantastischen schmeckenden und gesunden Kokoszucker zu kreieren. Kokosnuss Aminos Knoblauchsauce ist USDA Bio-zertifiziert, sojafrei, bio, zertifiziert (GF), glutenfrei, gentechnikfrei, ohne MSG, vegan und schmeckt hervorragend.

The Coconut Secret Story, uma verdadeira história de família. Quando os fundadores da Coconut Secret aprenderam que seus pais eram diabéticos, eles começaram com um desejo sincero de criar uma linha de produtos orgânicos, de baixa glicemia e sem glúten para diabéticos. E foi exatamente isso que aconteceu. Portanto, o nascimento do molho de tempero de coco aminos e alho. Leslie e Randy, fundadores, foram recompensados e abençoados além das expectativas, em sua descoberta de produtos tradicionais feitos a partir da seiva do maravilhoso coqueiro. Portanto, a criação de uma extensa linha de produtos à base de coco para satisfazer (e saciar) praticamente todos os tipos de desejo. Seu foco foi produzir uma linha de produtos que não fosse "processada" para eliminar a maioria dos nutrientes e enzimas naturais. Eles entenderam a importância para um corpo saudável ter nutrientes e enzimas presentes naturais, permitindo que o corpo digere naturalmente e o utilize nutricionalmente. Estes valores holísticos são fundamentais para os diabéticos e para qualquer pessoa que queira construir um corpo mais saudável. Uma abordagem holística, o açúcar de coco é feito coletando a "seiva" das flores de coqueiro. Recipientes de bambu são usados para coletar a seiva dos coqueiros nas flores. Quando os coqueiros são batidos, eles produzem uma "inflorescência" (seiva) que exala das flores de coco. Esta seiva naturalmente doce é glicêmica muito baixa (GI de 35), crua e enzimticamente viva, uma fonte abundante de 17 aminoácidos, minerais, vitamina C, vitaminas B de amplo espectro e tem um pH quase neutro. É minimamente evaporado a baixas temperaturas (apenas para remover o excesso de umidade), nunca excedendo um dia médio de verão nos trópicos. O resultado final é um produto similar a xarope conhecido como "criança" de coco que é usado para criar um sabor incrível e saudável de açúcar de coco. O molho de alho com aminoácidos de coco é certificado pela USDA orgânico, sem soja, orgânico, certificado (FF) sem glúten, sem OGM, sem MSG, vegano e tem ótimo sabor.

椰子秘密故事是一个真正的家庭故事。 当 Coconut Secret 的创始人学习他们的父母是糖尿病患者时,他们开始真诚地心愿为糖尿病患者创造有机,低血糖和无麸质产品线。 这正是发生的事情。 因此，椰子氨基酸大蒜调味酱的诞生。 Leslie 和 Randy 的创始人在发现了由奇妙的椰子树汁制成的传统产品时受到了超越预期的奖励和祝福。 因此,创造了大量的椰子基产品,以满足(和饱腹)几乎所有类型的渴望。 他们的重点是生产未经过"加工"的产品线,以消除大多数天然存在的营养和酶。 他们理解拥有天然存在的营养和酶对健康的身体至关重要,让身体自然消化和利用它的营养。 这些整体价值观对糖尿病患者以及任何想要建立更健康身体的人至关重要。 椰子糖是从椰子树花中收集"汁液"来制作的。 竹子容器用于收集椰子树的汁液。 椰子树被拍打后,会产生连续流动的"花式"(汁液),从椰子花中散发出来。 这种天然甜液是非常低的血糖(GI 35),原始和酶活性,是17种氨基酸,矿物质,维生素C,广谱B族维生素的丰富来源,并且具有几乎中性的pH。 然后在低温下微量蒸发(仅用于去除多余的水分),不会超过热带地区的平均夏季日。 最终结果是一种糖浆类产品,被称为"toddy",用来制造美味健康的椰子糖。 椰子氨基酸大蒜酱经过美国农业部有机认证,不含大豆,有机,经认证(GF)不含麸质,非转基因,不含MSG,素食,味道极好。

The Coconut Secret Story,一個真正的家庭故事。 當 Coconut Secret 的創始人知道他們的父母是糖尿病患者時,他們開始真誠地希望為糖尿病患者創造有機、低糖、無麩質的產品系列。 而這正是發生的事情。 因此,Coconut Aminos 大蒜調味醬誕生了。 創始人 Leslie 和 Randy 在發現由奇妙的椰子樹汁製成的傳統產品時獲得了超乎預期的獎勵和祝福。 因此,創造出一系列廣泛的椰子產品來滿足 (並滿足) 幾乎所有類型的渴望。 他們專注於生產未「加工」的產品系列,以消除大多數天然產生的營養物質和酶。 他們瞭解健康身體必須有天然產生的營養素和酶,讓身體自然消化和營養利用。 ​ 這些整體價值觀對於糖尿病患者以及任何想要打造更健康的身體的人來說至關重要。 ​ 採用整體方法,椰子糖是透過收集椰子樹開花的「汁」而製成。 竹子容器用於收集開花時椰子樹的汁液。 當椰子樹被敲打時,它們會產生從椰子開花中流出的持續流動的「花序」(sap)。 這種天然甜汁非常低血糖(GI 為 35),原始和酵素活著,17 種氨基酸、礦物質、維他命 C、廣譜 B 維他命的豐富來源,且具有幾乎中性的 pH值。 然後在低溫下稍微蒸發(僅為了去除多餘的水分),絕不超過熱帶地區平均的夏季天。 最終的結果是一種稱為椰子「toddy」的糖漿類產品,用來製作美味健康的椰子糖。 椰子氨基酸大蒜醬通過 USDA 有機認證、無大豆、有機認證(GF)無麩質、非轉基因、無味精、素食,味道絕佳。

코코넛 시크릿 스토리, 진정한 가족 이야기. Coconut Secret의 창립자가 부모가 당뇨병 환자라는 것을 알게 되자, 당뇨병 환자를 위한 유기농, 저혈당, 글루텐 프리 제품 라인을 만들고자 하는 진심 어린 열망으로 시작했습니다. 그리고 그것은 정확하게 일어난 일입니다. 따라서 코코넛 아미노스 마늘 시즈닝 소스가 탄생했습니다. 창립자인 레슬리와 랜디는 놀라운 코코넛 나무의 수액으로 만든 전통적인 제품을 발견하여 기대를 뛰어넘는 보상을 받고 축복을 받았습니다. 따라서, 코코넛 기반 제품의 광범위한 라인을 만들어 사실상 모든 종류의 욕구를 만족시키며(그리고 포만감을 줍니다) 그들의 초점은 자연 발생 영양소와 효소의 대부분을 제거하기 위해 "가공"되지 않은 제품 라인을 생산하는 것이었습니다. 그들은 건강한 신체가 자연적으로 발생하는 영양소와 효소가 존재하는 것이 중요하다는 것을 이해하여 신체가 자연적으로 소화하고 영양적으로 활용할 수 있습니다. 이러한 전체적인 가치는 당뇨병 환자와 건강한 몸을 만들고 싶은 모든 사람에게 매우 중요합니다. 전체적인 접근 방식인 코코넛 설탕은 코코넛 나무 꽃에서 "수액"을 수집하여 만들어집니다. 대나무 용기는 꽃에서 코코넛 나무의 수액을 수집하는 데 사용됩니다. 코코넛 나무를 두드려 보면 코코넛 꽃에서 발산되는 지속적으로 흐르는 "꽃차례"(수액)을 생성합니다. 이 천연 달콤한 수액은 매우 낮은 혈당(GI 35), 원료 및 효소 적으로 살아있으며, 17개의 아미노산, 미네랄, 비타민 C, 광범위한 스펙트럼 B 비타민의 풍부한 공급원이며 거의 중성 pH를 가지고 있습니다. 그런 다음 낮은 온도에서 최소한으로 증발시켜 (과도한 수분을 제거하기 위해서만), 열대 지방의 평균 여름날을 초과하지 않습니다. 결과적으로 코코넛 "toddy"라고 알려진 시럽과 같은 제품으로 멋진 맛과 건강한 코코넛 설탕을 만드는 데 사용됩니다. 코코넛 아미노스 마늘 소스는 USDA 유기농 인증을 받았으며, 콩 프리, 유기농, 인증(GF) 글루텐 프리, GMO 프리, MSG 없음, 비건 및 맛도 좋습니다.

Emilio's fascination with chiles began when he moved to New Mexico in 1890. Here he encountered the state's popular big red chiles. When he returned home to California a few years later, he brought with him chile pepper seeds and many recipes for dishes he had grown to love while in New Mexico. Back home with his family at their adobe house in Ventura, California, Emilio planted the chile seeds. Those chiles grew extremely well in the temperature climate of Ventura. Soon Emilio had so many chiles he had to give them away. Everyone loved them! That's when he knew he had something special. In 2003, B&G Foods purchased the Ortega brand. description:
Raw soy sauce as a dipping sauce for dumplings or sushi, in salad dressings or with steamed vegetables. soy sauce is freshly-pressed and unpasteurized. It is therefore characterized by a lighter color than other soy sauces, a sweeter aroma and smoother, more delicate taste. Soy sauce should be enjoyed as a dipping sauce only, as cooking with it spoils the delicate flavor.

Kishibori Shoyu is an artisanal soy sauce made by Takesan Co.,LTD, located on the small island of Shodoshima in the Seto Inland Sea, between the main Japanese island of Honshu and neighboring Shikoku. This soy sauce is made from high-quality whole soybeans, wheat and sun dried sea salt.

It is best enjoyed raw, but can also be used in cooking applications. Steamed soybeans, toasted wheat, salt, mineral water, and koji are left to ferment in old cider barrels for one year. The barrels themselves are very well seasoned and have been in use for over 100 years.

The mild winters in the region (the temperature does not go below 50F) encourage active fermentation throughout the year. This slow fermentation process results in the production of a huge number of complex organic acids. These components contribute to the umami and depth of flavors. Unlike mass-produced, main-stream soy sauce, this shoyu is not treated with additional alcohol or preservatives and is not adulterated by any additives. The filtered product is only pasteurized and then bottled.

title: Wicker's Marinade (Mesquite, 24 Ounce)
description: About Wicker's: Early in 1940. Peck developed a sauce recipe for barbecuing meat. He would dig an open earthen pit for the fire, fasten wire over it to hold the meat, then baste it with his special sauce throughout the cooking process. He shared his culinary art with church and lodge groups. Everyone who tasted wanted more. From this beginning, he started filling gallon jugs with sauce. But people still wanted more. So, in 1947, he constructed a small building near his home, the first Wicker’s barbecue sauce manufacturing facility. He bought the vinegar in quart bottles by the case. The woman who worked with him would soak the bottles to remove the labels, then help Peck re-fill the bottles with his wonderful vinegar-base sauce. He sold the products locally and to visitors seeking his barbecued meat and/or the sauce. There was no effort to distribute the sauce beyond his immediate locale. Peck sold his delicious barbecue by the pound each year from a stand on Main Street during the Farmers and Merchants Watermelon Festival. Several of his satisfied customers urged him to also offer barbecued pork sandwiches and a new idea was born. Peck enclosed an area behind his little manufacturing facility. The sides were covered with screen wire and the ground was covered with sawdust for the floor. Thus, “The Pit” came to be a reality. He operated his business only on weekends from May through October and many a Hornersville youth helped tend the pit and serve the customers who came from miles around. Word-of-mouth was his only advertising. It was not unusual to see a long waiting line on Saturday night and Sunday after Church. Sunday night almost became Blytheville Air Base Night. When the word got around, there was a sea of uniforms of all ranks in Hornersville. Wicker’s time honored products are still owned and handmade by local folks. As peck used to say, “WICKER’S IS THE TASTE SENSATION BEYOND IMAGINATION.”

title: Guglielmo's Marinara Sauces (Pumpkin Sauce, 2-Pack)
description: I can trace this recipe to at least the 1930s. My Great-Grandmother Mary Guglielmo was raising a family of 10. It was The Great Depression and any food that could be grown instead of purchased was preferred. For that reason, she maintained a garden, in place of her yard. Born in Italy, and being that items like tomatoes, garlic, peppers, and onions are easy to grow, one of her signature dishes was the homegrown sauce. Her sauce was exceptional. Between the process, she followed and the fresh ingredients she used, her sauce was like nothing else. Quickly, friends and family were clamoring for her to make them a batch. So she obliged every single request to make the sauce. At first, it was easy to keep up with demand, however, when my Grandpa Pete’s brothers and sisters started moving away, and when my Great Grandfather died, it was just Mary and her son, my Grandpa Pete, making the sauce. And still, people wanted her sauce. My Grandpa Pete decided that it was time to help his mom. It didn’t take long for him to perfect the recipe. Mary would eventually pass away, Grandpa Pete would marry my Grandma Lucy. Grandpa knew how to make Mary’s sauce. It remained a tradition. I was born and I was at Grandpa Pete’s house for sauce most Sundays. At first, all I knew was that my large Italian family met on Sundays and shared this meal together. I didn’t realize how spoiled I was to be feasting on this delicious, homegrown sauce. When I was in my early twenty’s, I decided to ask my Grandpa if he would show me how to make the sauce. I didn’t quite realize how rich of a family tradition I had just tapped into. Grandpa was so happy I had asked. No one had ever asked him before. He always thought the recipe would die with him. Grandpa Pete took me under his wing and my first lesson was in the tomato fields. The rest is history…

"تتميز صلصة الفودكا المصنوعة في المنزل من راو بمزيج غني من الطماطم الإيطالية وبامبيجيانو ريجيانو وجبن بيكورينو رومانو ورشة من الفودكا لصنع صلصة معكرونة كريمية ولامعة. باتباع وصفة رو الإيطالية المصنوعة منزليًا، فإن كل وعاء من الصلصة يجلب لك النكهة الكلاسيكية الدافئة لصوص الطماطم المنزلية. كل مجموعة من صلصة فودكا المعكرونة المنزلية من راو يتم طهيها ببطء بكميات صغيرة بمكونات عالية الجودة. هذه المكونات الصحية تمزج 100% من الطماطم الإيطالية الحلوة، وزيت الزيتون، وجبن البارميزان ورومانو والبصل والثوم والريحان والأوريجانو والفودكا مما يخلق صلصة سباغيتي متوازنة من المؤكد أنها ستسعد الجميع حول الطاولة. تبقى وصفة المعكرونة فودكا من رو مطابقة لجذورها الإيطالية الكلاسيكية بدون سكر مضافة* مما يجعلها صلصة معكرونة لذيذة مناسبة للكربوهيدرات وصديقة للكيتو. ليست هذه الصلصة الفاخرة لذيذة فحسب، بل إنها مصنوعة من أجود المكونات ولا تحتوي على أي خلطات الطماطم أو معجون الطماطم أو النشا أو الألوان المضافة. إن راو هوم ماد، الذي ولد في الأصل في نيويورك، يجلب الآن النكهة الإيطالية الأصلية إلى منزلك. صلصة المعكرونة الفودكا من رو هي عبارة عن صلصة معكرونة متعددة الاستخدامات مناسبة للكربوهيدرات والتي توفر نكهة إيطالية تقليدية محلية، متوفرة بسهولة في أي وقت لإقرانها مع المعكرونة المفضلة لديك، لاستخدامها كمكون في وصفتك المفضلة أو لصنع وعاء من صلصة بيني الا فودكا الكلاسيكية. *لا يحتوي على طعام منخفض أو منخفض السعرات الحرارية، انظر إلى لوح التغذية لمزيد من المعلومات حول محتوى السكر والسعرات الحرارية"

description: Riggo tomato sauce is the quickest and easiest way to make delicious pasta that would pass muster with an authentic Italian chef. Lots of people like adding meat to their sauce, but that takes time. Unlike most pasta sauces that you can find on the shelf in your local grocery store, we make Riggo with the meat right in the sauce. There’s no need to cook ground beef, sausage, or turkey to add protein to your meal. It’s already in there! This sauce saves everyone time and makes having pasta with delicious meat sauce quick and easy. Our pasta sauces come as an 8-pack, and each individual pouch contains two servings of sauce rather than the five servings you get with most jarred pasta sauces. More often than not, people don’t need an entire jar of pasta sauce so they usually sit half empty in the fridge, losing what flavor they had and going bad. This never made sense to us, so we knew our smaller pouches were the way to go. These two-serving pouches of sauce are extremely easy to prepare. Simply tear open the pouch, pour the contents into a microwaveable container, then cover and heat for 60 seconds. When your pasta is ready, pour the hot tomato sauce into the pot with the pasta or onto your plate. The sauce can also be microwaved right in the open pouch or heated in a saucepan. Because the sauce is so easy to prepare, it’s a great solution for on-the-go meals. There are three varieties available. For our meat sauce lovers, there’s Italian Sausage, Ground Turkey, and Ground Beef. For those who prefer pasta sauce without meat, there’s the simpler but still delectable Marinara Italiano. Because the sauce comes in two-serving pouches, it’s easy to customize your pasta for a family meal. Each person can enjoy their favorite kind of sauce without the hassle and waste of opening several jars and preparing separate sauces. Forget jarred pasta sauce and spaghetti sauce mix, and enjoy Riggo’s convenient and delicious pasta sauce packets!

description:
The Coconut Secret Story, a true family story. When the founders of Coconut Secret learned their parents were diabetic, they began with a heartfelt desire to create an organic, low glycemic, gluten-free product line for diabetics. And that is precisely what happened. Hence the birth of the Coconut Aminos Garlic Seasoning Sauce. Leslie and Randy, founders, were rewarded and blessed beyond expectations, in their discovery of traditional products made from the sap of the wondrous coconut tree. Hence, the creation of an extensive line of coconut-based products to satisfy (and satiate) virtually every kind of craving. Their focus was to produce a product line that was not "processed" to eliminate the majority of naturally occurring nutrients and enzymes. They understood the importance for a healthy body to have naturally occurring nutrients and enzymes present allowing the body to naturally digest and utilize it nutritionally. These holistic values are critical to diabetics, and anyone who wants to build a healthier body. A holistic approach, coconut sugar is made by collecting the "sap" from the coconut tree blossoms. Bamboo containers are used to collect the sap of the coconut trees right at the blossoms. When the coconut trees are tapped, they produce a continuously flowing "inflorescence" (sap) that exudes from the coconut blossoms. This naturally sweet sap is very low glycemic (GI of 35), raw and enzymatically alive, an abundant source of 17 amino acids, minerals, vitamin C, broad-spectrum B vitamins, and has a nearly neutral pH. It is then minimally evaporated at low temperatures (only to remove excess moisture), never exceeding an average summer day in the tropics. The end result is a syrup-like product known as coconut "toddy" which is used to create an awesome tasting and healthy coconut sugar. Coconut Aminos Garlic Sauce is USDA Organic certified, soy-free, Organic, Certified (GF) Gluten-Free, Non-GMO, No MSG, Vegan and tastes great.

הסיפור הסודי של הקוקוס, סיפור משפחתי אמיתי. כאשר המייסדים של Coconut Secret למדו שהוריהם היו סוכרתיים, הם החלו עם תשוקה מכל הלב ליצור קו מוצרים אורגני, גליקמי נמוך ונטול גלוטן לחולי סוכרת. וזה בדיוק מה שקרה. מכאן הולדתו של רוטב התיבול קוקוס אמינו. Leslie and Randy, מייסדים, זכו לתגמול ובורך מעבר לציפיות, בגילוי המוצרים המסורתיים העשויים מעץ הקוקוס המופלא. לפיכך, יצירת קו רחב של מוצרים מבוססי קוקוס כדי לספק (ו להשביע) כמעט כל סוג של תשוקה. ההתמקדות שלהם הייתה לייצר קו מוצרים שלא "מעובד" כדי לחסל את רוב החומרים המזינים והאנזימים המתרחשים באופן טבעי. הם הבינו את החשיבות של גוף בריא עם חומרים מזינים ואנזימים טבעיים הקיימים המאפשרים לגוף לעכל באופן טבעי ולנצל אותו באופן תזונתי. ערכים הוליסטיים אלה הם קריטיים לחולי סוכרת, וכל מי שרוצה לבנות גוף בריא יותר. גישה הוליסטית, סוכר קוקוס נעשה על ידי איסוף "סאפ" מפריחת עץ הקוקוס. מכלי במבוק משמשים לאיסוף התרופה של עצי הקוקוס ממש בפריחה. כאשר עצי הקוקוס מצומצמים, הם מייצרים "תפרחת" זורמת באופן רציף (סאפ) אשר נוטלת מפריחת הקוקוס. סאפ מתוק טבעי זה הוא גליקמי נמוך מאוד (GI של 35), גולמי וחי מבחינה אנזימטית, מקור בשפע של 17 חומצות אמינו, מינרלים, ויטמין C, ויטמינים B רחב טווח, ויש לו pH כמעט ניטרלי. לאחר מכן הוא מתאדה מינימלית בטמפרטורות נמוכות (רק כדי להסיר לחות עודפת), לעולם לא יעלה על יום קיץ ממוצע באזורים הטרופיים. התוצאה הסופית היא מוצר דמוי סירופ המכונה "טודי" קוקוס המשמש ליצירת טעם מדהים וסוכר קוקוס בריא. רוטב שום קוקוס אמינו הוא אורגני באישור משרד החקלאות האמריקאי, ללא סויה, אורגני, מוסמך (GF) ללא גלוטן, ללא הנדסה גנטית, ללא MSG, טבעוני וטעם נהדר.

The Coconut Secret Story, eine wahre Familiengeschichte. Als die Gründer von Coconut Secret lernten, ihre Eltern Diabetiker zu waren, begannen sie mit einem herzlichen Wunsch, eine organische, glykämische, glutenfreie Produktlinie für Diabetiker zu schaffen. Und genau das ist passiert. Daher die Geburt der Coconut Aminos Knoblauch-Sauce. Leslie und Randy, Gründer, wurden belohnt und gesegnet über die Erwartungen, in ihrer Entdeckung traditioneller Produkte aus dem Saft des wundersamen Kokosnussbaums. Daher ist die Schaffung einer umfangreichen Linie von Produkten auf Kokosnussbasis für praktisch jede Art von Verlangen (und sättigen) Befriedigung. Ihr Fokus war es, eine Produktlinie zu produzieren, die nicht "verarbeitet" wurde, um die Mehrheit der natürlich vorkommenden Nährstoffe und Enzyme zu beseitigen. Sie verstanden, wie wichtig für einen gesunden Körper ist, natürlich vorkommende Nährstoffe und Enzyme vorhanden zu haben, sodass der Körper auf natürliche Weise verdauen und nährungsphysiologisch verwertet werden kann. Diese ganzheitlichen Werte sind entscheidend für Diabetiker und alle, die einen gesünderen Körper aufbauen wollen. Ein ganzheitlicher Ansatz, Kokoszucker wird durch das Sammeln des "Saftes" aus den Kokosbaumblüten hergestellt. Bambusbehälter werden verwendet, um den Saft der Kokosbäume direkt an den Blüten zu sammeln. Wenn die Kokosbäume gezapft werden, produzieren sie einen kontinuierlich fließenden "Blütenblatt" (Sap), der aus den Kokosblüten ausströmt. Dieser natürlich süße Saft ist sehr niedrig glykämischer (GI von 35), roh und enzymatisch lebend, eine reichliche Quelle von 17 Aminosäuren, Mineralien, Vitamin C, Breitband-B-Vitaminen und hat einen nahezu neutralen pH-Wert. Es wird dann bei niedrigen Temperaturen minimal verdunstet (nur um überschüssige Feuchtigkeit zu entfernen), nie mehr einen durchschnittlichen Sommertag in den Tropen übersteigen. Das Endergebnis ist ein Sirup-ähnliches Produkt, das als Kokosnuss "Kleinkind" bekannt ist, das verwendet wird, um einen fantastischen schmeckenden und gesunden Kokoszucker zu kreieren. Kokosnuss Aminos Knoblauchsauce ist USDA Bio-zertifiziert, sojafrei, bio, zertifiziert (GF), glutenfrei, gentechnikfrei, ohne MSG, vegan und schmeckt hervorragend.

The Coconut Secret Story, uma verdadeira história de família. Quando os fundadores da Coconut Secret aprenderam que seus pais eram diabéticos, eles começaram com um desejo sincero de criar uma linha de produtos orgânicos, de baixa glicemia e sem glúten para diabéticos. E foi exatamente isso que aconteceu. Portanto, o nascimento do molho de tempero de coco aminos e alho. Leslie e Randy, fundadores, foram recompensados e abençoados além das expectativas, em sua descoberta de produtos tradicionais feitos a partir da seiva do maravilhoso coqueiro. Portanto, a criação de uma extensa linha de produtos à base de coco para satisfazer (e saciar) praticamente todos os tipos de desejo. Seu foco foi produzir uma linha de produtos que não fosse "processada" para eliminar a maioria dos nutrientes e enzimas naturais. Eles entenderam a importância para um corpo saudável ter nutrientes e enzimas presentes naturais, permitindo que o corpo digere naturalmente e o utilize nutricionalmente. Estes valores holísticos são fundamentais para os diabéticos e para qualquer pessoa que queira construir um corpo mais saudável. Uma abordagem holística, o açúcar de coco é feito coletando a "seiva" das flores de coqueiro. Recipientes de bambu são usados para coletar a seiva dos coqueiros nas flores. Quando os coqueiros são batidos, eles produzem uma "inflorescência" (seiva) que exala das flores de coco. Esta seiva naturalmente doce é glicêmica muito baixa (GI de 35), crua e enzimticamente viva, uma fonte abundante de 17 aminoácidos, minerais, vitamina C, vitaminas B de amplo espectro e tem um pH quase neutro. É minimamente evaporado a baixas temperaturas (apenas para remover o excesso de umidade), nunca excedendo um dia médio de verão nos trópicos. O resultado final é um produto similar a xarope conhecido como "criança" de coco que é usado para criar um sabor incrível e saudável de açúcar de coco. O molho de alho com aminoácidos de coco é certificado pela USDA orgânico, sem soja, orgânico, certificado (FF) sem glúten, sem OGM, sem MSG, vegano e tem ótimo sabor.

椰子秘密故事是一个真正的家庭故事。 当 Coconut Secret 的创始人学习他们的父母是糖尿病患者时,他们开始真诚地心愿为糖尿病患者创造有机,低血糖和无麸质产品线。 这正是发生的事情。 因此，椰子氨基酸大蒜调味酱的诞生。 Leslie 和 Randy 的创始人在发现了由奇妙的椰子树汁制成的传统产品时受到了超越预期的奖励和祝福。 因此,创造了大量的椰子基产品,以满足(和饱腹)几乎所有类型的渴望。 他们的重点是生产未经过"加工"的产品线,以消除大多数天然存在的营养和酶。 他们理解拥有天然存在的营养和酶对健康的身体至关重要,让身体自然消化和利用它的营养。 这些整体价值观对糖尿病患者以及任何想要建立更健康身体的人至关重要。 椰子糖是从椰子树花中收集"汁液"来制作的。 竹子容器用于收集椰子树的汁液。 椰子树被拍打后,会产生连续流动的"花式"(汁液),从椰子花中散发出来。 这种天然甜液是非常低的血糖(GI 35),原始和酶活性,是17种氨基酸,矿物质,维生素C,广谱B族维生素的丰富来源,并且具有几乎中性的pH。 然后在低温下微量蒸发(仅用于去除多余的水分),不会超过热带地区的平均夏季日。 最终结果是一种糖浆类产品,被称为"toddy",用来制造美味健康的椰子糖。 椰子氨基酸大蒜酱经过美国农业部有机认证,不含大豆,有机,经认证(GF)不含麸质,非转基因,不含MSG,素食,味道极好。

The Coconut Secret Story,一個真正的家庭故事。 當 Coconut Secret 的創始人知道他們的父母是糖尿病患者時,他們開始真誠地希望為糖尿病患者創造有機、低糖、無麩質的產品系列。 而這正是發生的事情。 因此,Coconut Aminos 大蒜調味醬誕生了。 創始人 Leslie 和 Randy 在發現由奇妙的椰子樹汁製成的傳統產品時獲得了超乎預期的獎勵和祝福。 因此,創造出一系列廣泛的椰子產品來滿足 (並滿足) 幾乎所有類型的渴望。 他們專注於生產未「加工」的產品系列,以消除大多數天然產生的營養物質和酶。 他們瞭解健康身體必須有天然產生的營養素和酶,讓身體自然消化和營養利用。 ​ 這些整體價值觀對於糖尿病患者以及任何想要打造更健康的身體的人來說至關重要。 ​ 採用整體方法,椰子糖是透過收集椰子樹開花的「汁」而製成。 竹子容器用於收集開花時椰子樹的汁液。 當椰子樹被敲打時,它們會產生從椰子開花中流出的持續流動的「花序」(sap)。 這種天然甜汁非常低血糖(GI 為 35),原始和酵素活著,17 種氨基酸、礦物質、維他命 C、廣譜 B 維他命的豐富來源,且具有幾乎中性的 pH值。 然後在低溫下稍微蒸發(僅為了去除多餘的水分),絕不超過熱帶地區平均的夏季天。 最終的結果是一種稱為椰子「toddy」的糖漿類產品,用來製作美味健康的椰子糖。 椰子氨基酸大蒜醬通過 USDA 有機認證、無大豆、有機認證(GF)無麩質、非轉基因、無味精、素食,味道絕佳。

코코넛 시크릿 스토리, 진정한 가족 이야기. Coconut Secret의 창립자가 부모가 당뇨병 환자라는 것을 알게 되자, 당뇨병 환자를 위한 유기농, 저혈당, 글루텐 프리 제품 라인을 만들고자 하는 진심 어린 열망으로 시작했습니다. 그리고 그것은 정확하게 일어난 일입니다. 따라서 코코넛 아미노스 마늘 시즈닝 소스가 탄생했습니다. 창립자인 레슬리와 랜디는 놀라운 코코넛 나무의 수액으로 만든 전통적인 제품을 발견하여 기대를 뛰어넘는 보상을 받고 축복을 받았습니다. 따라서, 코코넛 기반 제품의 광범위한 라인을 만들어 사실상 모든 종류의 욕구를 만족시키며(그리고 포만감을 줍니다) 그들의 초점은 자연 발생 영양소와 효소의 대부분을 제거하기 위해 "가공"되지 않은 제품 라인을 생산하는 것이었습니다. 그들은 건강한 신체가 자연적으로 발생하는 영양소와 효소가 존재하는 것이 중요하다는 것을 이해하여 신체가 자연적으로 소화하고 영양적으로 활용할 수 있습니다. 이러한 전체적인 가치는 당뇨병 환자와 건강한 몸을 만들고 싶은 모든 사람에게 매우 중요합니다. 전체적인 접근 방식인 코코넛 설탕은 코코넛 나무 꽃에서 "수액"을 수집하여 만들어집니다. 대나무 용기는 꽃에서 코코넛 나무의 수액을 수집하는 데 사용됩니다. 코코넛 나무를 두드려 보면 코코넛 꽃에서 발산되는 지속적으로 흐르는 "꽃차례"(수액)을 생성합니다. 이 천연 달콤한 수액은 매우 낮은 혈당(GI 35), 원료 및 효소 적으로 살아있으며, 17개의 아미노산, 미네랄, 비타민 C, 광범위한 스펙트럼 B 비타민의 풍부한 공급원이며 거의 중성 pH를 가지고 있습니다. 그런 다음 낮은 온도에서 최소한으로 증발시켜 (과도한 수분을 제거하기 위해서만), 열대 지방의 평균 여름날을 초과하지 않습니다. 결과적으로 코코넛 "toddy"라고 알려진 시럽과 같은 제품으로 멋진 맛과 건강한 코코넛 설탕을 만드는 데 사용됩니다. 코코넛 아미노스 마늘 소스는 USDA 유기농 인증을 받았으며, 콩 프리, 유기농, 인증(GF) 글루텐 프리, GMO 프리, MSG 없음, 비건 및 맛도 좋습니다.

bullet_point: [Authentic Shrimp Paste., Made from Shrimp 80%., Product of Thailand.(Ship from Thailand).]
description: Shrimp paste or shrimp sauce is made from fermented ground shrimp mixed with salt. Some versions are in its wet form such as those in Vietnam and other versions are sun dried and either cut into fist-sized rectangular blocks or sold in bulk. It is an essential ingredient in many curries and sauces. Shrimp paste can be found in most meals in Myanmar, Laos, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Vietnam and the Philippines. It is often an ingredient in dip for fish or vegetables. In Thailand shrimp paste or shrimp sauce (kapi) is an essential ingredient in many types of nam phrik, spicy dips or sauces, and in all Thai curry pastes, such as the paste used in kaeng som. Very popular in Thailand is nam phrik kapi, a spicy condiment made with fresh shrimp paste and most often eaten together with fried pla thu (Short mackerel) and fried, steamed or raw vegetables. In Southern Thailand there are three types of shrimp paste: one made only from shrimp, one containing a mixture of shrimp and fish ingredients, and another paste that is sweet.

description:
Trader Joe's Habanero Hot Sauce

The flavor is all habanero and garlic with a bit of that onion in the mix, but at a lesser level. I could have sworn I tasted some carrot in there, as well, but it’s not listed so maybe the sauce’s color is playing mind tricks on me.

The texture of this one, for me anyways, is spot on. It’s not runny or watery. Trader Joe’s Habanero Sauce is chunky and full on the palate — chewy even without accompanying food. You can feel the bits of pepper and seeds as you enjoy the sauce.

The burn on this one fully engulfs the tongue and inside of the lips. It builds smoothly to a moderately high level before fading slowly, leaving a fiery tingle in the chest. Like I said above, it surprised me at first as I wasn’t expecting that sort of punch from a habanero sauce, but I’ve grown accustomed to its warm embrace.

This product from Trader Joe’s has become a staple in my meager collection of hot sauces. It goes on just about everything, but I particularly love it on tacos and burgers. The manufacturer has done a great job with this one, allowing the peppers to stand on their own, only seasoning where needed.

description: The 150 year Ortega tradition all started with Maria Conception Jacinta Dominguez Ortega, or as we like to call her, Mama. Mama Ortega. Mama's memorable cooking did more than just bring her family together. It was in Mama's kitchen that her 11th child, Emilio, established the Ortega Chile Packing Company. Emilio's fascination with chiles began when he moved to New Mexico in 1890. Here he encountered the state's popular big red chiles. When he returned home to California a few years later, he brought with him chile pepper seeds and many recipes for dishes he had grown to love while in New Mexico. Back home with his family at their adobe house in Ventura, California, Emilio planted the chile seeds. Those chiles grew extremely well in the temperature climate of Ventura. Soon Emilio had so many chiles he had to give them away. Everyone loved them! That's when he knew he had something special. In 2003, B&G Foods purchased the Ortega brand. Like Emilio Ortega, B&G Foods has a long tradition of commitment to quality. So today, when a family picks up a can of chiles or a box of taco shells, they know they are getting the very best. This web site has been created to continue the rich heritage of the Ortega family. By sharing our collection of delicious Mexican recipes, we hope to help you create fond memories of great meals shared with your family.

description: Bourbon Barrel Foods is a maker of gourmet food products that reflect the rich heritage of Kentucky's Bourbon Country, "The Napa Valley of the Bluegrass." Their philosophy is to make quality gourmet sauces and seasonings by adhering to a three-word philosophy: slow, small, simple. From the farmer in southern Kentucky that grows the soybeans for naturally fermented, small-batch soy sauce, to the grower in Eastern Kentucky that harvests the sorghum used as a sweetener, Bourbon Barrel Foods have a hands-on approach that requires them to search for the best their state has to offer and develop relationships with the farmers that get great satisfaction seeing their crops grow from the seed to the shelf. Bluegrass Soy Sauce is a great artisan soy sauce with wonderful flavor and body. Made from non-GMO Kentucky grown soybeans. Brewed and aged in bourbon barrels. The result is a smoky, broth sauce with hints of oak and mild sweetness reminiscent of the fine Kentucky bourbon. When he returned home to California a few years later, he brought with him chile pepper seeds and many recipes for dishes he had grown to love while in New Mexico. description:
We'll tell you the secret: it's the Puya peppers. What's the question? That's up to you; we're just making hot sauces here! Our traditional hot sauce is a loving homage to those table sauces, given the Siete spin by including nutrient dense ingredients like flax seed, Chia, and golden beets. When it comes to hot sauce, We approach it with a “flavor first, fire second” mentality. Our sauces are not meant to be daredevil, burn-your-esophagus hot. We hope spice lovers of all degrees can appreciate that we dial down the heat in order to turn up the flavor.

Wir sagen Ihnen das Geheimnis: es sind die Puya Paprika. Was ist die Frage? Das liegt an Ihnen. Wir machen hier nur heiße Saucen. Schlummern Sie in jedes lässige Restaurant in Mexiko und Sie finden eine Soße wie diese auf dem Tisch. Unsere traditionelle heiße Soße ist eine liebevolle Hommage an Tischsoßen, die Siete Spin durch nährstoffdichte Zutaten wie Leinsamen, Chia und goldene Rüben enthält. Wenn es um heiße Soße geht, kommen wir ihm mit einem "Geschmack zuerst, Feuer zweit" Mentalität an. Unsere Soßen sind nicht als trauwürdig gedacht, verbrennen Sie Ihre Speiseröhre heiß. Wir hoffen, dass Gewürzliebhaber aller Abstufungen schätzen können, dass wir die Hitze abschalten, um den Geschmack zu verbessern.

אנחנו נספר לכם את הסוד: זה פלפלי Puya. מה השאלה? זה תלוי בך; אנחנו רק מכינים רטבים חריפים כאן! טיילו לתוך כל מסעדה מזדמנת במקסיקו ותמצאו רוטב כמו זה על השולחן. הרוטב החריף המסורתי שלנו הוא מחווה אוהבת לרטבי שולחן אלה, בהתחשב בסיט סיט על ידי הוספת מרכיבים צפופים מזינים כמו זרעי פשתן, צ'יה וסלק זהב. כשמדובר ברוטב חריף, אנחנו מתקרבים אליו עם מנטליות "טעם ראשון, אש שנייה". הרטבים שלנו לא נועדו להיות מרדודים, לשרוף את הוושט שלך. אנו מקווים שאוהבי התבלינים בכל המעלות יוכלו להעריך את העובדה שאנו מוציאים את החום כדי להגביר את הטעם.

Vamos te contar o segredo: são as pimentas Puya. Qual é a pergunta? Isso depende de você; estamos apenas fazendo molhos quentes aqui! Passeie em qualquer restaurante casual do México e você encontrará um molho como este na mesa. Nosso molho quente tradicional é uma homenagem amorosa aos molhos de mesa, dada a rotação Siete ao incluir ingredientes densos de nutrientes como sementes de linho, chia e beterraba dourada. Quando se trata de molho quente, abordamos com uma mentalidade "sabor primeiro, fogo segundo". Nossos molhos não são feitos para serem Demolidor, queimar seu esôfago quente. Esperamos que os amantes de temperos de todos os graus apreciem que diminuímos o calor para aumentar o sabor.

我们将告诉你秘密:普亚胡椒是普亚胡椒。 问题是什么? 这由您决定;我们只是在这里制作辣酱! 漫步于墨西哥的任何休闲餐厅,桌上就会找到这样的酱汁。 我们的传统辣酱是对这些餐桌酱的爱的致敬,Siete 通过加入营养丰富的成分,如亚麻籽、奇亚和金甜菜。 说到辣酱,我们用"第一,第二火"的心态来做。 我们的酱汁不意味着胆恶、灼伤您的食管。 希望所有程度的香料爱好者都能欣赏到,我们通过调温热量来增加味道。

我們會告訴您秘密:這是 Puya 辣椒。 問題是什麼? 這取決於您;我們只是在這裡製作辣醬! 漫步到墨西哥的任何休閒餐廳,您會在桌上找到類似 This 醬汁。 由於 Siete 的旋轉方式包括亞麻籽、奇亞和金甜菜等營養密集成分,我們的傳統辣醬是對這些桌醬的熱愛致敬。 說到熱醬,我們以「風味第一,點火第二」的心態處理。 我們的醬料並非要冒膽、燒傷您的食道熱。 我們希望所有程度的香料愛好者都能欣賞到我們撥下熱量以提升風味。 ​

description: Tsurubishio is the flagship series of soy sauce for Yamaroku and is aged the longest between 3-5 years. "Tsuru" means "crane" and "Bishio" means "condiment". In Japan, cranes are regarded as auspicious birds and symbolize longevity. It is said the song of cranes can reach the heavens, and Yamaroku wants this soy sauce to be like the cranes which can reach the heavens and be known to everyone. Tsurubishio is characterized as having a rich mellow flavor and is recommended for use in sushi, sashimi, tofu, grilled fish and as a secret ingredient for original dishes. A unique use of Tusurubishio is putting it on top of vanilla ice cream which creates a very caramel like flavor. Adds a surprise twist for guests and customers at a restaurant. This soy sauce is made using the traditional and authentic method to ferment Japanese condiments since ancient times using Japanese wooden barrels called kioke. Due to modern mass production of soy sauce, only 1% of total soy sauce production in Japan uses this traditional method. Get a taste of Japanese history almost lost in modern times by trying and enjoying this classic condiment done right.

Picante Sauce

Pace Picante Sauce is the perfect ingredient or dip for whatever you’re craving. It’s made with smoothly blended tomatoes, chunks of savory onions, and fresh, handpicked jalapeños. Pace Picante Sauce is available in Mild, Medium, and Hot.

Hot, Layered Taco Dip:

This recipe features layers of deliciousness piled on top of each other, with a Southwest flair. It’s perfect for any, and every, gathering.

What You’ll Need:

  • 1 pound ground beef
  • 1 jar (16 ounces) Pace Picante Sauce
  • 1 can (about 15 ounces) refried beans
  • 1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese (about 4 ounces)
  • Chopped tomato
  • Shredded lettuce

How To Make It:

  1. Heat the oven to 350°F.
  2. Cook the beef in a 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat until it's well browned, stirring often to separate meat. Pour off any fat. Stir the picante sauce in the skillet and cook until the mixture is hot and bubbling.
  3. Spread the beans on the bottom of a 2-quart shallow baking dish. Top with the beef mixture and sprinkle with the cheese.
  4. Bake for 10 minutes or until the cheese is melted. Top with the tomato and lettuce, if desired.

To convert into a sauce, use our Canyon Road Enchilada Sauce recipe. Canyon Road Red Enchilada Dry Sauce Q & A What is enchilada seasoning? A traditional Mexican dish that's popular in Tex-Mex cuisine, enchiladas consist of a a filling like meat, cheese, or beans wrapped in a tortilla that is covered with a chile-based sauce. Enchilada seasoning captures the flavors of enchilada sauce in dry form and is made using a variety of ground chiles and other spices. What does enchilada sauce taste like? Made primarily with dried chiles, red enchiliada sauce is rich and can be spicy depending on the specific chiles used. It also typically includes aromatic ingredients like onion and garlic. Green enchilada sauce is similar, though typically less spicy and made with green poblano peppers instead of red chiles. Cooking With Canyon Road Red Enchilada Dry Sauce For a paste, mix equal parts water, oil, and spice. Though this is called a "dry sauce," it can also be used as a seasoning. description:
Creamy Lemon Chicken with Mushrooms
You Will Need
6 - 8 skinless chicken breast fillets
1 t Ina Paarman's Lemon & Black Pepper Seasoning
2 T Ina Paarman's White Sauce Powder
1 T butter
1 T canola or olive oil
250 g punnet mushrooms, thickly sliced
1 x 200 ml Ina Paarman’s Lemon & Herb Coat & Cook Sauce
1 cup fresh cream
2 t Ina Paarman's Chicken Flavour Stock Powder

Method
Adjust the oven rack to middle position.

Preheat oven to 356°F.

Cut each breast fillet across the grain on the diagonal into 4 pieces. Mix Seasoning and White Sauce Powder, sprinkle over the chicken and mix through.

Warm an empty fry pan over high heat, add the butter and oil. Add the chicken and stir-fry briefly until lightly browned on the outside, but still raw inside. Toss the mushrooms in with the chicken, do not cook them. Immediately dish the mixture into a medium size ovenproof dish.

Add the Lemon & Herb Sauce, cream and Stock Powder to the fry pan and heat, while stirring and scraping with a wooden spoon, to incorporate all the nice brown bits. Pour over the chicken. Bake open for 20 – 25 minutes. Delicious with Buttered Tagliatelle to soak up the sauce. Serve a crisp green salad on the side, dressed with one of our Vinaigrette Dressings.

Product Sizing
200ml

Renfro Foods was founded in 1940 in Fort Worth, Texas, distributing packaged spices and pepper sauces throughout the surrounding areas. Mrs. Renfro's salsas gained popularity fast, earning a reputation for quality flavor at a reasonable price that stands to this day. Mrs. Renfro's brand now includes more than 30 salsas, quesos, peppers, relishes, and sauces---award winners and critically celebrated flavors from mild to wild to exotic to flavorfully fruity---including Black Bean, Habanero, Peach, Chipotle Corn, Roasted, Pineapple, Raspberry Chipotle, Garlic, Mango Habanero, and the king of heat, Ghost Pepper salsa (made with the world's hottest chile pepper, Bhut Jolokia). We add carrot, dates, and golden beets to accentuate the sweetness, as well as quillaja extract, sea salt and garlic for picante más sabor!, MEDIUM/HOT HEAT: We give it “3 out of 5 flames,” perfect for roasted pumpkin seeds, burritos, dips, salsa, and other great food you want to kick up a notch., WHOLE30 & VEGAN: Dairy-free, soy-free, gluten-free, grain-free, corn-free, non-GMO, no preservatives, Paleo & Whole30 approved. It’s not magic… but it kinda is when you think about it.]
description:
The Habanero is the tiger of chiles. Like the tiger, the pepper evokes ideas of exoticism, power, beauty, and fear. The challenge in making this sauce was to show the beauty and sweetness of the tiger, rather than the, y'know, Siegfried & Roy side. So we tamed the beast, adding golden beets, carrots, and dates to accentuate the pepper's sweetness, making the dangerous heat more of a through-line that conducts the orchestra of flavors than a solo artist. While this is the hottest of our sauces, it's a playful heat that we think you'll find pleasant in its restraint. That big scary predator is just a sweet cat at heart. When it comes to hot sauce, we approach it with a “flavor first, fire second” mentality. Our sauces are not meant to be daredevil, burn-your-esophagus hot. We hope spice lovers of all degrees can appreciate that we dial down the heat in order to turn up the flavor.

Habanero הוא הנמר של צ'ילים. כמו הנמר, הפלפל מעורר רעיונות של אקזוטיות, כוח, יופי ופחד. האתגר בהכנת הרוטב הזה היה להראות את היופי והמתיקות של הנמר, במקום זאת, אתה יודע, זיגפריד ורוי. אז אילפנו את החיה, הוספנו סלק, גזר ותאריכים כדי להדגיש את המתיקות של הפלפל, מה שהופך את החום המסוכן ליותר קו דרך שמנהל את התזמורת של טעמים מאשר אמן סולו. למרות שזה הכי חם של רטבים שלנו, זה חום שובב שאנחנו חושבים שתמצאו נעים במגבלות שלו. הטורף הגדול המפחיד הזה הוא רק חתול מתוק בלב. כשמדובר ברוטב חריף, אנו מתקרבים אליו עם מנטליות "טעם ראשון, אש שנייה". הרטבים שלנו לא נועדו להיות מרדודים, לשרוף את הוושט שלך. אנו מקווים שאוהבי התבלינים בכל המעלות יוכלו להעריך את העובדה שאנו מוציאים את החום כדי להגביר את הטעם.

Der Habanero ist der Tiger der Chilis. Wie der Tiger weckt der Pfeffer Ideen von Exotik, Kraft, Schönheit und Angst. Die Herausforderung bei der Herstellung dieser Sauce war es, die Schönheit und Süße des Tigers zu zeigen, anstatt die Siegfried & Roy Seite zu zeigen. Daher zähmen wir das Biest, fügen goldene Rüben, Karotten und Datteln hinzu, um die Süße des Pfeffers zu betonen, wodurch die gefährliche Hitze eher als ein Solokünstler leitet. Während dies die heißeste unserer Soßen ist, ist es eine spielerische Hitze, die wir denken, dass Sie in ihrer Zurückhaltung angenehm finden. Dieses große gruselige Raubfisch ist nur eine süße Katze im Herzen. Wenn es um heiße Soße geht, greifen wir es mit einem "Geschmack zuerst, Feuer zweit" Mentalität an. Unsere Soßen sind nicht als trauwürdig gedacht, verbrennen Sie Ihre Speiseröhre heiß. Wir hoffen, dass Gewürzliebhaber aller Abstufungen schätzen können, dass wir die Hitze abschalten, um den Geschmack zu verbessern.

هابانيرو هو نمر شيلز. مثل النمر، يثير الفلفل أفكارًا عن الغريب والقوة والجمال والخوف. كان التحدي في صنع هذه الصلصة هو إظهار جمال وحلاوة النمر، بدلاً من ذلك، على سبيل المثال، سيغريد ورو. لذلك قمنا بتهذيب الوحش، بإضافة الشمندر الذهبي والجزر والتواريخ لإبراز حلاوة الفلفل، مما يجعل الحرارة الخطرة أكثر من مجرد خط يقوم بتوصيل الأوركسترا من النكهات أكثر من فنان فردي. في حين أن هذه هي الأكثر إثارة في الصلصات لدينا، إلا أنها حرارة ممتعة نعتقد أنك ستجد متعة في قييدها. هذا المفترس الكبير المخيف هو مجرد قطة حلوة في القلب. عندما يتعلق الأمر بالصوص الساخنة، فإننا نقترب منها بعقلية "النكهة أولًا، إطلاق النار الثاني". لا يُقصد أن تكون الصلصات التي نقدمها جريئةً أو ساخنةً. نأمل أن يُقدر عشاق التوابل من جميع الدرجات لخفض الحرارة من أجل رفع النكهة.

O Habanero é o tigre dos chiles. Como o tigre, a pimenta evoca ideias de exotismo, poder, beleza e medo. O desafio em fazer este molho era mostrar a beleza e a doçura do tigre, em vez do lado Siegfried & Roy. Então dominamos a fera, adicionando beterraba dourada, cenouras e datas para acentuar a doçura da pimenta, tornando o calor perigoso mais de uma linha que conduz a orquestra de sabores do que um artista individual. Embora este seja o mais quente dos nossos molhos, é um calor divertido que achamos que você encontrará agradável em sua contenção. Aquele grande predador assustador é apenas um doce gato de coração. Quando se trata de molho quente, nós o abordamos com uma mentalidade "sabor primeiro, fogo segundo". Nossos molhos não são feitos para serem Demolidor, queimar seu esôfago quente. Esperamos que os amantes de temperos de todos os graus apreciem que diminuímos o calor para aumentar o sabor.

Habanero 是智利的老虎。 像老虎一樣,胡椒喚起了異國情調、力量、美和恐懼的想法。 製作醬料的挑戰是展示老虎的美麗和甜美,而不是 Siegfried & Roy 的一面。 因此,我們馴服了野獸,加入了金甜菜、胡蘿蔔和日期,以突顯胡椒的甜味,使危險的熱量更像是一條通行的味道,而不是一個獨奏藝術家。 雖然這是我們最熱門的醬料,但卻是一種俏皮的熱量,我們認為您會在它的限制中感到愉悅。 那隻大可怕的捕食者只是一隻可愛的貓。 說到熱醬,我們以「風味第一,點火第二」的心態處理。 我們的醬料並非要冒膽、燒傷您的食道熱。 我們希望所有程度的香料愛好者都能欣賞到我們撥下熱量以提升風味。 ​

Habanero 是智利的老虎。 像老虎一样,胡椒唤起了异域主义、力量、美感和恐惧的想法。 制作这种酱汁的挑战是展示老虎的美丽和甜蜜,而不是 Siegfried 和 Roy 的一面。 所以我们驯养了野兽,添加了金甜菜、胡萝卜和约会来突出胡椒的甜度,危险的热量比独奏艺术家更是指挥风味的管弦乐团。 虽然这是我们最火辣的酱汁,但它是一种俏皮的热量,我们认为您会在它的束缚中感到愉悦。 那个大吓人的掠夺者只是一只可爱的猫。 说到辣酱,我们以"第一,第二火"的心态对待。 我们的酱汁不意味着胆恶、灼伤您的食管。 希望所有程度的香料爱好者都能欣赏到,我们通过调温热量来增加味道。

하바네로는 칠레스의 호랑이입니다. 호랑이와 마찬가지로 후추는 이국주의, 힘, 아름다움, 두려움에 대한 아이디어를 불러일으킵니다. 이 소스를 만드는 도전은 호랑이의 아름다움과 달콤함을 보여주는 것이었습니다. Y'know, Siegfried & Roy 쪽이 아닙니다. 그래서 우리는 야수를 길들이고 황금 사탕무, 당근, 날짜를 추가하여 고추의 달콤함을 강조하여 솔로 아티스트보다 맛의 오케스트라를 전달하는 위험한 열을 더 많이 만듭니다. 이 제품은 저희 소스 중 가장 인기 있는 제품이지만, 장난 열기로 인해 기분이 좋다고 생각합니다. 이 크고 무서운 포식자는 마음 속 귀여운 고양이입니다. 핫소스에 관해서는 "맛 우선, 파이어 세컨드" 정신으로 접근했습니다. 우리의 소스는 데어데블, 식도를 태우기 위한 것이 아닙니다. 우리는 모든 학위 애호가들이 풍미를 높이기 위해 열을 내려 전화를 걸 수 있다는 것을 감상 할 수 있기를 바랍니다.

description: Kikubishio is the flagship series of soy sauce for Yamaroku and is aged the longest between 3-5 years. "Kiku" means "cchrysanthemum" and "Bishio" means "condiment". In Japan, cranes are regarded as auspicious birds and symbolize longevity. It is said the song of cranes can reach the heavens, and Yamaroku wants this soy sauce to be like the cranes which can reach the heavens and be known to everyone. Tsurubishio is characterized as having a rich mellow flavor and is recommended for use in sushi, sashimi, tofu, grilled fish and as a secret ingredient for original dishes. A unique use of Tusurubishio is putting it on top of vanilla ice cream which creates a very caramel like flavor. Adds a surprise twist for guests and customers at a restaurant. This soy sauce is made using the traditional and authentic method to ferment Japanese condiments since ancient times using Japanese wooden barrels called kioke. Due to modern mass production of soy sauce, only 1% of total soy sauce production in Japan uses this traditional method. Get a taste of Japanese history almost lost in modern times by trying and enjoying this classic condiment done right.

Mild heat with a hint of sweet, this sauce goes great on any dish! Aji Chombo is a traditional Panamanian Style hot sauce heavily influenced by the Caribbean. The Aji Chombo (Scotch Bonnet) pepper was first used in Panama by the Antilleans who settled there from various Caribbean Islands. The hot sauces they created from these peppers are typically vinegar based and are commonly referred to as Aji Chombo or Chombo Picante. You will find Aji Chombo on most restaurants in Panama, especially those on the Atlantic Coast where the Antillean descendants make up the majority of the population. There are many different variations as each restaurant and individual has their own special recipe. You can use Aji Chombo on just about anything. Use it to liven up any dish, add it to soup or use it as a marinade. Unlike most Habanero hot sauces, the Aji Chombo hot sauce starts off with a burn that turns into a blast of flavor.

Poured out of the bottle, Kikkoman Sweet & Sour Sauce offers a delicious shortcut preparation for one of the most popular Chinese dishes, sweet and sour pork. Tradicionalmente elaborada salsa de soja Kikkoman, pasta de tomate, piña, cebolla, pimiento verde, ajo y pimiento rojo picante se mezclan juntos para dar a esta salsa un sabor verdaderamente asiático. Además, Sweet and Sour Sauce es una excelente salsa de inmersión para aperitivos y alimentos para los dedos, como toneladas fritas ganadas y alas de pollo.

Molho de soja Kikkoman tradicionalmente preparado, pasta de tomate, abacaxi, cebola, pimentão verde, alho e pimenta vermelha picante são misturados juntos para dar a este molho um sabor verdadeiramente asiático. description: Amarillo is our third installment of our Caribbean style hot sauces from Panama. We use select yellow scotch bonnets and tweaked our Original recipe. Slightly hotter than our Original with another great flavor! Aji Chombo is a traditional Panamanian Style hot sauce heavily influenced by the Caribbean. The Aji Chombo (Scotch Bonnet) pepper was first used in Panama by the Antilleans who settled there from various Caribbean Islands. The hot sauces they created from these peppers are typically vinegar based and are commonly referred to as Aji Chombo or Chombo Picante. You will find Aji Chombo on most restaurants in Panama, especially those on the Atlantic Coast where the Antillean descendants make up the majority of the population. There are many different variations as each restaurant and individual has their own special recipe. You can use Aji Chombo on just about anything. Use it to liven up any dish, add it to soup or use it as a marinade. Unlike most Habanero hot sauces, the Aji Chombo hot sauce starts off with a burn that turns into a blast of flavor.

description: In Japan, two fermented soya sauces, Shoyu and Tamari, have been favourite seasonings for several centuries. Today, these delicious, ebony-coloured sauces are appreciated all over the world. The difference between Shoyu and Tamari lies in their composition. Shoyu is made of soya and wheat whereas Tamari is a pure soya sauce. The nutritional value of Shoyu Shoyu stimulates the appetite and contains several pinerals, proteins and indispensable vitamins. During the long fermentation process, natural enzymes transform the starch, the proteins and the lipids contained in raw soya and wheat into nutrients that are easily absorbed, as they are predigested : amino acids, poly-unsaturated fatty acids, slow carbohydrates... … During the fermentation process, a lactic acid is developed that has a beneficial effect on the intestinal flora and on the efficient absorption of nutrients. Sea salt supplies minerals and trace elements. By using the Lima sauces instead of salt, you reduce the amount of salt in your dishes while enhancing their natural taste. Usage: Shoyu and Tamari are taste enhancers, healthy and liquid versions of stock cubes. They are suitable for western as well as oriental dishes. Do not simply use them to salt, but also to intensify the natural taste of ingredients during cooking and at the table. Thanks to its higher protein content, the concentrated taste of Tamari resists heat better. Moreover, it makes the ingredients to which it is combined more tender. Traditionally, Tamari is used to enhance the taste of stews, pasta, soups, fried vegetables, salad dressings, marinades or wok preparations... Tamari is especially suitable for use in combination with vinegar or rice wine, ginger, garlic, mustard, pepper or ume su (Japanese vinegar).

title: Wicker's Marinade (Thicker, 24 Ounce)
description: About Wicker's: Early in 1940. Peck developed a sauce recipe for barbecuing meat. He would dig an open earthen pit for the fire, fasten wire over it to hold the meat, then baste it with his special sauce throughout the cooking process. He shared his culinary art with church and lodge groups. Everyone who tasted wanted more. From this beginning, he started filling gallon jugs with sauce. But people still wanted more. So, in 1947, he constructed a small building near his home, the first Wicker’s barbecue sauce manufacturing facility. He bought the vinegar in quart bottles by the case. The woman who worked with him would soak the bottles to remove the labels, then help Peck re-fill the bottles with his wonderful vinegar-base sauce. He sold the products locally and to visitors seeking his barbecued meat and/or the sauce. There was no effort to distribute the sauce beyond his immediate locale. Peck sold his delicious barbecue by the pound each year from a stand on Main Street during the Farmers and Merchants Watermelon Festival. Several of his satisfied customers urged him to also offer barbecued pork sandwiches and a new idea was born. Peck enclosed an area behind his little manufacturing facility. The sides were covered with screen wire and the ground was covered with sawdust for the floor. Thus, “The Pit” came to be a reality. He operated his business only on weekends from May through October and many a Hornersville youth helped tend the pit and serve the customers who came from miles around. Word-of-mouth was his only advertising. It was not unusual to see a long waiting line on Saturday night and Sunday after Church. Sunday night almost became Blytheville Air Base Night. When the word got around, there was a sea of uniforms of all ranks in Hornersville. Wicker’s time honored products are still owned and handmade by local folks. As peck used to say, “WICKER’S IS THE TASTE SENSATION BEYOND IMAGINATION.”

It is said the song of cranes can reach the heavens, and Yamaroku wants this soy sauce to be like the cranes which can reach the heavens and be known to everyone. Tsurubishio is characterized as having a rich mellow flavor and is recommended for use in sushi, sashimi, tofu, grilled fish and as a secret ingredient for original dishes. A unique use of Tusurubishio is putting it on top of vanilla ice cream which creates a very caramel like flavor. Adds a surprise twist for guests and customers at a restaurant. This soy sauce is made using the traditional and authentic method to ferment Japanese condiments since ancient times using Japanese wooden barrels called kioke. Due to modern mass production of soy sauce, only 1% of total soy sauce production in Japan uses this traditional method. Get a taste of Japanese history almost lost in modern times by trying and enjoying this classic condiment done right.

description: Mitoku’s Organic Yaemon Tamari is an exquisite, rich, dark soy sauce made by naturally aging soybeans in brine for more than 18 months. It is produced by one of the few remaining authentic tamari producers in Japan, the Minamigura Aoki Yaemon Company. While an excellence choice for those with allergies to wheat, the amazing cooking qualities makes it a go to product for top cooks around the world. How is it different from the rest? Traditional made Tamari, such as Mitoku’s Yaemon, is long aged in wood, contains no wheat, and is made with a very high percentage of whole soybeans. It accounts for a very small part of the world’s tamari production. According to Japanese Agriculture Standards (JAS), even a product made with 20% wheat can still be called tamari. Mitoku’s Yaemon Tamari has 0% wheat! On the subject of soybean percentages… Modern tamari manufacturers make a much more dilute product than Mitoku’s Yaemon Tamari. They often use 10 parts soybeans to 10 parts water which saves money and is much easier to process. What's more, most tamari is made by the rapid commercial process using hexane-defatted soybeans fermented at high temperatures for three to six months, and often bottled with additives. Authentic Go-Bu Tamari, such as Mitoku Yaemon’s, uses 10 parts soybeans to only 5 parts water. This results in a rich, concentrated tamari extracted from a very thick and difficult to press mixture. Stick with the genuine article.

When he returned home to California a few years later, he brought with him chile pepper seeds and many recipes for dishes he had grown to love while in New Mexico. description:
Green Yuzu Kosho (Ao Kosho) is an exceptional - and exceptionally spicy - Japanese condiment that makes a lasting impression.

With a slightly coarse texture, similar to pesto, Yuzu Kosho leaves a distinctly sour/salty/spicy flavor lingering on the palate.

A specialty of the cuisine of Kyushu, a region in southeastern Japan, Yuzu Kosho is made from three ingredients only: yuzu, a prized and very tart Japanese citrus fruit, chile peppers and salt.

Yuzu Kosho comes in two varieties: Red Yuzu Kosho (Aka Kosho), made with red chiles, yuzu zest & salt, and Green Yuzu Kosho (Ao Kosho), made with green chiles, yuzu zest & salt.

How To Use Yuzu Kosho:
Yuzu kosho makes an excellent condiment, used sparingly straight from the jar. Add flavor and heat to Asian dishes like tofu, noodles, sashimi, sushi, dipping sauces, hot-pots and stir frys.

But Yuzu Kosho is not just for Asian-style dishes. Use Yuzu Kosho as a rub on pork, beef or fish. Add a dash to marinades, salad dressings, soups and sauces. Incredible with poultry - add it to your favorite Buffalo wings recipe for a powerful punch of spicy-citrusy flavor!

description: The 150 year Ortega tradition all started with Maria Conception Jacinta Dominguez Ortega, or as we like to call her, Mama. Mama Ortega. Mama's memorable cooking did more than just bring her family together. It was in Mama's kitchen that her 11th child, Emilio, established the Ortega Chile Packing Company. Emilio's fascination with chiles began when he moved to New Mexico in 1890. Here he encountered the state's popular big red chiles. When he returned home to California a few years later, he brought with him chile pepper seeds and many recipes for dishes he had grown to love while in New Mexico. Back home with his family at their adobe house in Ventura, California, Emilio planted the chile seeds. Those chiles grew extremely well in the temperature climate of Ventura. Soon Emilio had so many chiles he had to give them away. Everyone loved them! That's when he knew he had something special. In 2003, B&G Foods purchased the Ortega brand. Like Emilio Ortega, B&G Foods has a long tradition of commitment to quality. So today, when a family picks up a can of chiles or a box of taco shells, they know they are getting the very best. This web site has been created to continue the rich heritage of the Ortega family. By sharing our collection of delicious Mexican recipes, we hope to help you create fond memories of great meals shared with your family.

Butter Chicken - Easy to prepare instructions

You will need:
2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 lb chicken breast (diced), 1 jar of Patak's Butter Chicken Cooking Sauce, and rice.

Stove-Top Meathod:
1. Heat oil in large skillet.
2. Add the chicken and saute until the meat is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Drain off any excess fat.
4. Pour sauce over chicken and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes. Add water if more sauce is required. Serve hot over rice.

Over Method:
1. In large casserole dish, combine chicken and cooking sauce.
2. Bake at 400°F until chicken is cooked through, about 50-60 minutes. Serve hot over rice.

تجلب صلصة ريد هوت سويت تشيلي من فرانكز نكهات آسيوية عصرية إلى مجموعة متنوعة من الوصفات، حيث تمزج قطع الفلفل الحار التايلاندي الأصلي مع الثوم والمكونات الممتازة لتحقيق التوازن المثالي للحلوة. بصفتها العلامة التجارية رقم 1 في أمريكا، يقدم فرانكز ريدهوت العديد من الفوائد، بما في ذلك: - الراحة: عند شراء خيار معبأ مثل فرانكز ريدهوت، فإنك تحد من عدد المكونات التي تحتاجها للشراء والسماح للموظفين الذين يتخفون من المنزل بالتجارب والخطأ والتركيز على ما هو الأكثر أهمية - طهي طعام مذهل! - جاذبية بصرية: يتباين اللون الزاهي لهذه الصلصة الساخنة المستوحاة من التايلاندية بنتوءات مذهلة من الفلفل الحار الأحمر الحقيقي. معًا، هذه الميزات البصرية تجعل كل منتج على قائمة المنتجات منغشة مع صلصة الفلفل الحار ريد هوت من فرانكز جديرة بالصور. - مكونات بسيطة: على عكس العديد من الصلصات الساخنة الحلوة الأخرى، فإن هذا المنتج يحتوي على وصفة خالية من شراب الذرة عالي الجودة للحصول على نكهة طبيعية متوازنة. كما أن صلصة الفلفل الحار الحلوة هذه خالية من منتجات الألبان ونباتية، لذا سيتاح لك الكثير من ضيوفك الاستمتاع بها. تضيف صلصة ريد هوت سويت تشيلي من فرانكز لمسة من الجمال والحيوية إلى: - تاكو شارع بانكوك مع الرومين الممزق وسالسا الذرة المحمص بالنار والبصل الأخضر ملفوفة في قشرة تورتيلا دافئة وناعمة - ثدي دجاج مقرمش يعلو بالأناناس البحري وجالابينيس الطازج والبقدونس المفروم - بيتزا هاواي مع لحم والأناناس والجلابينوس والموزاريس. لا شيدا القديمة. AR - أجنحة الدجاج التايلاندية الحلوة مع خل الأرز والزنجبيل المبشور والثوم - فول سوداني للحوم المقشفة، يتم شحن صلصة الفلفل الحلو ريد هوت من فرانك وتخزينها في درجات الحرارة المحيطة، ولها عمر افتراضي 15 شهرًا وهو الأفضل إذا تم استخدامها حسب تاريخ الكود. لتقليل خطر التلوث والحفاظ على أقصى طعم وجودة المنتج بين التطبيقات، قم بحماية الصلصة من التجمد وتخزينها مع الغطاء مغلقًا بإحكام.

bullet_point: [Red Yuzu Kosho is a deliciously spicy Japanese condiment, Yuzu Kosho has a slightly coarse texture with a zingy citrus flavor., Red Yuzu Kosho is made from three ingredients only: yuzu zest, green chiles and salt., A specialty of the cuisine of Kyushu, a region in southeastern Japan, Yuzu Kosho leaves a distinctly sour/salty/spicy flavor lingering on the palate.]
description: A specialty of the cuisine of Kyushu, a region in southeastern Japan, Yuzu Kosho is made from three ingredients only: yuzu, a prized and very tart Japanese citrus fruit, chile peppers and salt. While the word "kosho" typically refers to black pepper in most of Japan, in the Kyushu dialect it has the specific meaning of "chile pepper." Yuzu Kosho comes in two varieties: Red Yuzu Kosho (Aka Kosho), made with red chiles, yuzu zest & salt, and Green Yuzu Kosho (Ao Kosho), made with green chiles, yuzu zest & salt. Yes, the two versions are distinctly different and each has a flavor profile that lends itself to different preparations. How To Use Yuzu Kosho Yuzu kosho makes an excellent condiment, used sparingly straight from the jar. Add flavor and heat to Asian dishes like tofu, noodles, sashimi, sushi, dipping sauces, hot-pots and stir frys. Use Yuzu Kosho as a rub on pork, beef, fish or chicken. Add a dash to marinades, salad dressings, soups and sauces.

description:
Lillie's Q’s mission is to bring people together at the table to experience authentically crafted Southern barbeque flavors true to their regions and traditions. As Chef Charlie McKenna traveled the BBQ competition circuit from Memphis to Alabama and the Carolinas, he created a Lillie's Q sauce unique to each region and won the Memphis in May World Championship Barbecue Cooking Contest along the way...twice! Now, he’s serving up Southern BBQ that’s true to regional traditions while still creating unique, reimagined flavors—it’s an art form. Thanks to Grandma Lillie, a full family lineage of BBQ passion, and a commitment to craft, we believe we’ve mastered it. With four restaurants and a variety of sauces, rubs, mixes and more—we’re excited to show you why it's unlike anything you’ve ever tasted. Our Smoky Barbeque Sauce with spicy cayenne from Memphis has a dash of smoke! This Memphis-style BBQ sauce is mild and sweet with brown sugar—a Memphis tradition. All of our BBQ sauces can go on basically everything, but our Smoky BBQ Sauce is the perfect grilling sauce for slow-cooked ribs and smoked chicken. Lillie's Q uses all-natural ingredients that are worth writing home about! Our barbeque sauces are made from a unique blend of all-natural ingredients and are made with gluten-free ingredients. That means no high fructose corn syrup, no MSG, no modified food starches, and no artificial colors or preservatives. We like to call it #SmotherlyLove. So with every bite, know you're enjoying flavors as authentic as the places they come from.

La misión de Lillie's Q es reunir a la gente en la mesa para experimentar sabores de barbacoa del sur auténticamente elaborados fieles a sus regiones y tradiciones. Mientras el chef Charlie McKenna viajó por el circuito de competición de barbacoa de Memphis a Alabama y Carolinas, creó una salsa Q de Lillie única para cada región y ganó el Memphis en el Concurso de Cocina de Barbacoa del Campeonato Mundial de Mayo en el camino... ¡dos veces! Ahora, está sirviendo la barbacoa del sur que es fiel a las tradiciones regionales mientras que todavía crea sabores únicos y reimaginados, es una forma de arte. Gracias a la abuela Lillie, un linaje familiar completo de pasión por la barbacoa y un compromiso con la artesanía, creemos que lo hemos dominado. Con cuatro restaurantes y una variedad de salsas, frotaciones, mezclas y mucho más, estamos encantados de mostrarte por qué es diferente a cualquier cosa que hayas probado. Nuestra salsa de barbacoa ahumada con cayena picante de Memphis tiene un poco de humo! Esta salsa de barbacoa estilo Memphis es suave y dulce con azúcar morena, una tradición Memphis. Todas nuestras salsas de barbacoa pueden ir básicamente todo, pero nuestra salsa ahumada BBQ es la salsa perfecta para costillas cocidas lentas y pollo ahumado. Lillie's Q utiliza ingredientes naturales que vale la pena escribir en casa. Nuestras salsas de barbacoa están hechas de una mezcla única de ingredientes totalmente naturales y están elaboradas con ingredientes sin gluten. Eso significa que no hay jarabe de maíz de alta fructosa, sin MSG, sin almidones de alimentos modificados, y sin colores artificiales ni conservantes. Nos gusta llamarlo #SmotherlyLove. Así que con cada bocado, sepa que estás disfrutando de sabores tan auténticos como los lugares de los que proceden.

تتمثل مهمة ليلي كيو في جمع الناس على الطاولة لتجربة نكهات الشواء الجنوبية المصنوعة بشكل أصلي بما يتوافق مع مناطقه وتقاليدهم. بينما سافر الشيف تشارلي مكنيا في دائرة منافسة الشواء من ممفيس إلى ألاباما وكارولينا، ابتكر صلصة ليلي كيو الفريدة لكل منطقة وحصلت على ممفيس في مسابقة طهي الشواء في بطولة العالم في مايو على طول الطريق...مرتين! الآن، إنه يخدم حفلات شواء جنوبي بما يتوافق مع التقاليد الإقليمية بينما لا يزال يصنع نكهات فريدة ومذهلة - إنه شكل فني. بفضل جراندما ليلي التي تقدم مجموعة عائلية كاملة من شغف حفلات الشواء، والالتزام بالحرفية، نعتقد أننا أتقناها. مع أربعة مطاعم ومجموعة متنوعة من الصلصات والفرك والخلطات وأكثر من ذلك - نحن متحمسون لنعرض لك سبب عدم وجود أي شيء تذوقه. صلصة الشواء الدخانية مع الكاين الحار من ممفيس لها القليل من الدخان! صلصة الشواء هذه على شكل ممفيس خفيفة وجميلة مع السكر البني - تقليد ممفيس. يمكن لجميع صلصات الشواء الخاصة بنا أن تكون كل شيء بشكل أساسي، ولكن صلصة الشواء الدخاني الخاصة بنا هي صلصة الشواء المثالية للأضلاع المطبوخة ببطء والدجاج المدخن. تستخدم ليليز كيو مكونات طبيعية بالكامل تستحق الكتابة عنها في المنزل. صلصات الشواء الخاصة بنا مصنوعة من مزيج فريد من المكونات الطبيعية بالكامل ومصنوعة من مكونات خالية من الغلوتين. وهذا يعني أنه لا يوجد مشروب ذرة عالي الكفاءة، ولا يحتوي على ميثيل سلفونيل الميثان الجيد، ولا يحتوي على نشا طعام معدلة، ولا يحتوي على ألوان صناعية أو مواد حافظة. نود أن نسميه #SmotherlyLove. لذا مع كل قضمة، تعلم أنك تستمتع بنكهات أصلية مثل الأماكن التي تأتي منها.

title: Tabasco Hot Pepper Live Plant
description: The Tabasco Pepper is a variety of hot chili pepper. This particular pepper was named after a city in Mexico. Tabasco peppers are a medium sized variety, measuring around two inches in length, at maturation. They are oblong shaped and bright red in color. At harvesting time, the peppers will be rather wrinkled and slightly thin skinned. This variety is the only chili pepper that is juicy on the inside and not dry. These peppers are most commonly used in Tabasco sauce and peppered vinegar. In the past, peppers, for the manufacturing of Tabasco sauce, were cultivated and harvested in Louisiana on Avery Island. Today, the largest part of these is grown in South and Central America. Avery Island grows all of the Tabasco seeds and a small amount of peppers. South and Central America have a better climate and more acreage to cultivate the maximum amount of peppers. Peppers can also be grown year round. Tabasco peppers grow upright on the plant and do not hang down, like most other pepper pods.

description:
Siete Habanero Hot Sauce
The Habanero is the tiger of chiles. Like the tiger, the pepper evokes ideas of exoticism, power, beauty, and fear. The challenge in making this sauce was to show the beauty and sweetness of the tiger, rather than the, y'know, Siegfried & Roy side. So we tamed the beast, adding golden beets, carrots, and dates to accentuate the pepper's sweetness, making the dangerous heat more of a through-line that conducts the orchestra of flavors than a solo artist. While this is the hottest of our sauces, it's a playful heat that we think you'll find pleasant in its restraint. That big scary predator is just a sweet cat at heart. When it comes to hot sauce, we approach it with a “flavor first, fire second” mentality. That’s why our Habanero Hot Sauce gets “3 out of 5 flames” for spiciness even though some habanero sauces are even spicier.

    Siete is not just about food, but community, putting family first, and being together better. Our rule is family first, family second, everything else third. description:
In response to a large number of requests, we also developed a robust and spicy version or our award winning sauce. I've had some sauces that seemed to rip the roof off your mouth, leaving you barren of taste sensation for days. While we wanted to have a nice spicy version, we didn't want to mask the great flavor with tongue searing heat. The result is a blend of different chili's, all chosen for their distinctive flavor balanced with heat. We think you'll find the Robust and Spicy a nice change in the long line of hot sauces. You'll experience the rush of heat, but you'll also enjoy that unique flavor that has made Barrel no. 51 a leader in the BBQ market.

As with our original Smokey Bourbon BBQ Sauce, the Robust and Spicy version is low sodium, made from all natural ingredients and is preservative free.
Enjoy our Robust and Spicy anytime you need to add a punch to ribs, chicken, burgers or any meat you want to spice up. Try brushing some on a slab of salmon, sprinkle with lemon pepper and a little butter, wrap in foil and grill until flaky. It's a different flavor sensation, and one you'll love.

Barrel no. 51 was developed from a desire to do something together as a family. So often, when kids grow up, everyone splits off and goes their own way. That's a fact of life. But we wanted to stay involved in each others lives in some way, so we decided to take our love of BBQ a step further. We wanted to start a business that would allow us to have a retirement income, something we could all be part of and at the same time, support some organizations that do great work for disabled children, care of the elderly and provide support for our military personnel and their children. It is our privilege at Barrel no. 51 to donate 25% of our profits to responsible, non-profit organizations dedicated to helping children, the elderly and our brave military personnel.

description:
Okay. Yeah. We know. Dehydrated soy sauce. Whaaaaaat?

So to begin, soy sauce is made from fermented paste composed of mashed soy beans, roasted wheat, brine, and Aspergillus mold. The paste is then squeezed and the liquid is what we know as soy sauce, which is then pasteurized and bottled. Dehydrated soy sauce is that liquid boiled down until only solids remain. These solids are then lightly toasted and milled into a fine, sand-colored powder.

Liquid soy sauce can be made with this powder by mixing one part dehydrated soy sauce to one and a half parts water. Makes it easy for when you want to take soy sauce with you on a vacation or camping trip, but don’t want to carry a heavy bottle of liquid. Other uses include adding to dry meat rubs and mixtures or homemade pasta dough.

Nando’s originated in South Africa, but we grow our PERi-PERi throughout Southern Africa—especially in Mozambique. Responsibility is core to our business, so we choose to empower more than 1,400 farmers by growing our own PERi-PERi across nearly 500 acres in the region.
